data_availability_verified.note: MNQ 12-26 has no 1-minute data on this machine; it is outside the range anyway.

logic.concept: For each of up to three sessions, isolate the FIRST 1-minute candle, wait for it to close, and trade in its direction (green long, red short).
logic.entry: Direction of the session's first 1-minute candle, at its close
logic.take_profit: FixedDistance 40 points (default), or RewardMultiple of actual risk

timeframe_requirement: HARD REQUIREMENT: 1 Minute primary. Anything else is a config error and blocks all orders.
order_fill_resolution: High / Tick / 1  (set by the strategy when UseTickPrecision is on)
commission_note: Set on the NinjaTrader account commission template, not in NinjaScript.
